Question B-006-011-008.

Why the correct answer is right: Front-to-back ratio compares forward radiation with radiation in the opposite direction.

Per-choice notes:
- sourceIndex 0: "The ratio of the power radiated in the forward direction to the power radiated in the opposite direction": Correct. Front-to-back ratio compares forward radiation with radiation in the opposite direction.
- sourceIndex 1: "The ratio of the power radiated by the director element, to the power radiated by the reflector element": Those may be Yagi design features, but traps are what enable multiband element behaviour here.
- sourceIndex 2: "The ratio of the length of the director element, to the length of the reflector element": Those may be Yagi design features, but traps are what enable multiband element behaviour here.
- sourceIndex 3: "The ratio of the driven element-to-director spacing, to the driven element-to-reflector spacing": Those may be Yagi design features, but traps are what enable multiband element behaviour here.
